prayerExcerpt.en-US: He bore out by his witness what he celebrated in mystery and confirmed by example what he preached with his lips.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Demonstrou com o testemunho o mistério que celebrava e confirmou com o exemplo a palavra que pregava com sua boca.

meta.face: A man of about sixty with a diamond-shaped face — a narrow forehead and a narrow, firm chin, broadest at high, prominent cheekbones; a strong, high-bridged aquiline Roman nose; deep-set, dark, thoughtful eyes under straight black brows flecked with grey; a thin, firm mouth; close-cropped black hair receding at the temples and greying above the ears; a short, close-trimmed black beard following the line of the jaw, grizzled at the chin; a calm, attentive gaze slightly to one side.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; the tradition shows him in the pallium with the anchor of his legendary drowning in the Black Sea. The Roman features and short grizzled beard are our choice, set against the city's harbour, to keep him apart from the other early popes.
